editedExercise.name: Standard Push-Up

instructions.description: Place hands under or slightly wider than the shoulders and extend the legs.
Maintain a controlled line through the trunk.
Lower your chest by bending your elbows through a comfortable range, without letting your chest touch the floor.
Press the floor away to return to the start.

variations.variationDescription: Standard Push-Up — Intensity Progression: Place hands on an elevated surface to reduce intensity (Incline Push-Up). To increase intensity, place your feet on an elevated surface (Decline Push-Up).

variationSuggestions.variationDescription: Standard Push-Up — Tempo-Controlled Version: Use a deliberately slower lowering phase without creating a separate database record.
Standard Push-Up — Reduced-Range Version: Use a smaller comfortable range while preserving the same movement pattern.

commentsNotes: Elevate the hands if trunk control cannot be maintained.
